overall_narrative_summary: Full text of target study S1052 — Kurup KB (1991), 'Community Based Approaches in Water Supply and Sanitation Programme -- An Indian Experience', Social Indicators Research 24:403-414 — is not accessible due to a PDF retrieval mismatch. The 9-page PDF supplied in the source text is an entirely different publication: May Yacoob (1990), 'Community self-financing of water supply and sanitation: what are the promises and pitfalls?', Health Policy and Planning 5(4):358-366 (containing zero mention of Kurup or India). Per protocol rules prohibiting guessing study design or risk-of-bias ratings from a citation or title when the target paper's full text is unavailable, chosen_tool, overall_rating, and all seven cross-tool summary domains are set to 'cannot_tell'. For reconciliation transparency, if the erroneously attached Yacoob (1990) article were itself the intended object of appraisal, it is a non-systematic narrative policy commentary/essay with no primary empirical sample, no Methods section, and no systematic search, which would map to chosen_tool = 'NONE'.
